scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome check client package.json
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm exec biome check --write client package.json
scripts.lint:server: server/.venv/bin/ruff check server && server/.venv/bin/ruff format --check server
scripts.lint:server:fix: server/.venv/bin/ruff check --fix server && server/.venv/bin/ruff format server
scripts.test:server:coverage: server/.venv/bin/coverage run --source=server -m unittest discover -s server/tests -t server -p 'test_*.py' && server/.venv/bin/coverage report
